source: 715 Shadow Merchant
target: 715 Mercator Umbrae

source: Jebus reorganized his thoughts and said, “We can become more attuned to certain needs and find suitable candidates to fulfill them.
target: Jebus cogitationes suas disposuit et dixit: “Possumus ad certas necessitates magis accommodari et reperire candidatos idoneos ad eas implendas.

source: We can also facilitate the corresponding transactions through our words and connections.”
target: Praeterea, per verba nostra et nexus, transactiones pertinentes efficere possumus.”

source: With his Conspirer’s mind, Lumian pondered seriously for two seconds before fully grasping Jebus’s true meaning.
target: Mentem Conspiratoris gerens, Lumian serio per duo secundos meditatus est antequam plene sensum verum Jebus intellexit.

source: Amused, he said, “Put it in simpler terms that are closer to mysticism.”
target: Iocose, dixit: “Explica hoc in verbis simplicioribus quae mysticismum propius attingunt.”

source: Jebus glanced at Franca and Jenna and eagerly explained, “I have two primary abilities.
target: Jebus Francam et Jennam intuens et alacriter explicavit: “Duo facultates principales habeo.

source: One is called Gray Perception.
target: Una vocatur Perceptio Cinerea.

source: I can more acutely sense the gray areas between white and black, including my desire and need to enter that gray domain.
target: Possum acutius percipere spatia cinerea inter album et nigrum, incluso desiderio atque necessitate in illud cinereum regnum intrandi.

source: The other is exceptional eloquence.
target: Alterum est eloquentia eximia.

source: This includes mastery of language and the ability to observe others’ expressions and decipher their words.”
target: Haec includit dominatum linguae et facultatem aliorum vultuum expressiones contemplandi atque eorum verba interpretandi.”

source: “That’s it?” Lumian asked, raising his eyebrows.
target: “Sic est?” quaesivit Lumian, supercilia levans.

source: “That’s it,” Jebus replied candidly with a shake of his head.
target: “Sic est,” respondit Jebus candiditer, capite nutante.

source: “Don’t Brokers charge fees for their services?” Lumian inquired with a smile.
target: “Nonne Intermediarii pro officiis suis mercedes exigunt?” inquirivit Lumian cum subrisu.

source: “Before reaching a deal, we will agree on a price with both parties.
target: “Antequam pactum efficiatur, cum utrisque partibus de pretio conveniemus.

source: Sometimes, we don’t even ask for one.
target: Aliquando, ne pretium quidem petimus.

source: It’s mainly to establish and maintain relationships,” Jebus answered seriously.
target: Praecipue ad relationes instaurandas et conservandas pertinet,” respondit Jebus serio.

source: “None of this involves any superpowers.”
target: “Haec omnia non involvunt ullas potentias supernaturales.”

source: I had thought a Broker’s Beyonder powers could derive corresponding benefits from every transaction they facilitate, including Beyonder enhancements.
target: Existimabam potentias Beyonder Intermediarii ex omni transactione, quam facilitamus, utilitates correspondentis adipisci posse, inter quas etiam Beyonder meliorationes contineantur.

source: However, this is clearly an exaggeration.
target: Attamen, hoc plane exaggeratio est.

source: It doesn’t seem to belong to Sequence 9…
target: Non videtur pertinere ad Sequentiam IX…

source: The two abilities Jebus mentioned are very fitting for those at Sequence 9.
target: Duae facultates, quas Jebus enumeravit, valde respondent illis in Sequentia IX.

source: From the looks of it, Brokers and Spectators are quite similar.
target: Ex aspectu, Intermediarii et Spectatores satis similes videntur.

source: They can hardly participate directly in Beyonder battles and are considered more supplementary support…
target: Vix directe in pugnis Beyonder participare possunt, atque ut subsidia complementaria censentur…

source: Lumian nodded in enlightenment.
target: Lumian caput annuit, illustratus.

source: Franca asked with interest, “What’s Sequence 8?”
target: Franca cum studio quaesivit: “Quae est Sequentia VIII?”

source: “It’s Shadow Merchant,” Jebus replied with a smile as he gazed at the Demoness of Pleasure’s face.
target: “Est Mercator Umbrae,” respondit Jebus subrisu, vultum Demonissae Voluptatis contemplans.

source: Without waiting for Franca to inquire further, he took the initiative to explain, “We can detect mysterious creatures and dangerous entities hidden in darkness and shadow while remaining safe from their attacks, thereby allowing us to reach certain deals with them.”
target: Sine expectare ut Franca ulterius quaereret, ipse inchoavit explicare: “Possumus detegere creaturas arcanae et entia periculosa, quae in tenebris et umbra latent, dum a suis ictibus secure remaneamus, quo nobis pacta quaedam cum illis pertingere liceat.”

source: Jenna couldn’t help but ask, “Invulnerable to hidden mysterious creatures and dangerous entities?”
target: Jenna non potuit non quaerere: “Invulnerabilis an es creaturis arcanae et entia periculosa, quae latent?”

source: Isn’t this ability too powerful?
target: Nonne haec facultas nimis potens esse videtur?

source: Jebus replied with a smile, “That’s usually the case, but you can’t attack the other party first or secretly exert any influence that’s disadvantageous to them.
target: Jebus subrisu respondit: “Saepe ita est, sed alteram partem primum oppugnare neque potes nec occulto ullam vim in eorum detrimentum afferre.

source: You can’t harbor malice when striking a deal, lest the other party discovers it.
target: Non licet tibi malitiam fovere dum pactum conficias, ne altera pars eam detegat.

source: Furthermore, you’ll suffer indiscriminate damage if embroiled in a battlefield.
target: Praeterea, si in acie commiscearis, damna indiscriminata tibi incursa erunt.

source: You can’t make creatures engaged in combat stand down.”
target: Creaturas in pugna certantes non potes cohibere ut cessent.”

source: “What if you see something you shouldn’t?” Lumian asked after some thought.
target: “Quid si aliquid vides, quod videre non decet?” quaesivit Lumian post paulum cogitandum.

source: “I will endure the corresponding corruption,” Jebus answered without attempting to boast.
target: “Corrumpitionem correspondentem patiar,” respondit Jebus, sine gloriari conatu.

source: “So it seems a Shadow Merchant possesses an aura that prevents nearby creatures from harboring malice towards them?” Franca realized.
target: “Ita videtur Mercatorem Umbrae auram possidere, quae creaturas proximas a malitia erga eum prohibet?” intellexit Franca.

source: Jebus praised, “Madame, your summary is better than mine.
target: Jebus laudavit: “Domina, tua compendiosa relatio meliore est quam mea.

source: However, it’s not that you don’t generate malice at all, but that you reduce their malice to a certain extent.
target: Sed non est, quod omnino malitiam non generes, sed eam ad aliquem gradum minuas.

source: The higher the other party’s level, the weaker the effect.
target: Quo altior est status alterius partis, eo minuitur effectus.

source: In other words, interacting with those mysterious creatures and dangerous entities to reach a deal is still risky and requires courage.”
target: In aliis verbis, commercia cum creaturis arcanae et entibus periculosis ad pactum efficiendum adhuc sunt periculosa et constantiam requirunt.”

source: At this point, Jebus chuckled.
target: Ad hoc, Jebus subridens cachinnavit.

source: “Taking risks is a necessary quality for successful merchants.”
target: “Pericula suscipere virtus necessaria est mercatoribus prosperis.”

source: “From the looks of it, you embody that?” Lumian deliberately provoked.
target: “Ex speciem, hoc te exprimere videtur?” provocavit Lumian deliberato.

source: “Of course,” Jebus replied proudly.
target: “Certe,” respondit Jebus cum superbia.

source: “I’ve made deals with many dangerous creatures and obtained valuable items.
target: “Pacta cum multis creaturis periculosissimis confeci et res pretiosas adeptus sum.

source: Then, through new deals, I used them to exchange for more useful items from believers of the Great Mother, the Mother Tree of Desire, and other Beyonders.
target: Tum, per nova pacta, ea ab credentibus Magnae Matris, Arboris Desiderii, et aliis Beyonderibus ad res utiliores commutavi.

source: These include bullets that can absorb life, bullets that cause a target’s implosion, and bullets that can impregnate a human, among other things.”
target: Haec includunt globulos, qui vitam absorbere possunt; globulos, qui implosionem obiecti efficiunt; et globulos, qui hominem fecundare possunt, inter alia.”

source: Bullets that can impregnate a human… Lumian was suddenly traumatized.
target: Globuli qui hominem fecundare possunt… Lumian subito turbatus est.

source: He was grateful he hadn’t given Jebus a chance to fire that bullet.
target: Gratus erat quod Jebus occasionem illud globulum emittere non dederat.

source: Franca and Jenna felt an inexplicable fear, their bodies turning cold.
target: Franca et Jenna metum inexplicabilem sentirent, et corpora eorum frigida facta sunt.

source: Even Anthony’s expression shifted slightly.
target: Etiam vultus Anthoni paulum mutatus est.

source: Jebus’s gaze swept across Franca, Jenna, Lumian, and his friend Anthony.
target: Jebus oculos suos percurrit in Francam, Jennam, Luminum, et amicum suum Anthoni.

source: He said solemnly,
target: Dixit sollemniter:

source: “Using our connections with various creatures, we Shadow Merchants can assist you in obtaining anything you desire, as long as you pay a sufficient price.
target: “Per coniunctiones nostras cum variis creaturis, nos Mercatores Umbrae possumus tibi auxilio esse ad omnia optata obtinenda, dummodo pretium idoneum solvas.

source: Of course, we can’t guarantee success in every transaction.”
target: “Certe, non possumus in omni transactione certitudinem successus praestare.”

source: “I want the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway,” Lumian said with a smile.
target: “Formula potionis Sequentiae IV viae Venatoris mihi cupio,” inquit Lumian subrisu.

source: Jebus fell silent for a moment before saying, “It will take an extremely long time to find someone who can provide the corresponding formula through multiple intermediaries.
target: Jebus momentaneum silentium tulit antequam diceret: “Diuturnum erit tempus ad aliquem inveniendum qui per multifarios intermedios formulam correspondentem praebere valeat.

source: “The one who ultimately makes the deal with you might even pose a danger to you.”
target: “Qui denique cum te pacto conficiet, fortasse tibi periculum quidem constituet.”

source: Lumian had only been joking.
target: Lumian solum iocabatur.

source: He deliberately sighed and said, “Then let’s put that aside for now.
target: Ille deliberato suspiravit et dixit: “Ergo hoc pro nunc relinquamus.

source: “What other abilities does a Shadow Merchant possess?
target: “Quae alias facultates Mercator Umbrae possidet?

source: Your abilities can’t be limited to just reducing the malice of surrounding creatures and detecting hidden entities.”
target: Facultates tuae non possunt solum constare in malitiam creaturarum circumstantium minuentibus atque in entia abscondita detegendis.

source: Jebus finally met Lumian’s gaze.
target: Jebus tandem in oculos Luminum conspexit.

source: “I’ve used some of them in my battles with you, including concealing myself in shadows, transforming into a shadow, and creating fake shadows.
target: “Aliquas ex his in certaminibus cum te usus sum, inter quas me in umbris celare, in umbram transformari, et umbras falsas creare.

source: They’re more protective abilities.
target: Haec sunt facultates protectivae.

source: I collectively call them ‘Shadow Utilization.’”
target: Eos universim “Usus Umbrae” appellavi.

source: Franca sighed with emotion.
target: Franca affectu suspiravit.

source: “Shadow Merchants can utilize not only symbolic shadows, but also shadows in reality.”
target: “Mercatores Umbrae non solum umbras symbolicas, sed etiam umbras reales adhibere possunt.”

source: Encouraged, Jebus continued, “We can also sign contracts with the shadows of both parties as witnesses, directly connected to each other’s souls.
target: Fovendus, Jebus perrexit: “Possumus etiam contractus cum umbris utriusque partis signare, ut testes sint, qui animas inter se directe coniungant.

source: If we violate the contract, the shadows will harm our spirits.
target: Si contractum violaverimus, umbrae animos nostros laedebunt.

source: It’s like a powerful curse.”
target: Est quasi maledictum potentem.”

source: “I see…” Franca recalled the fellow she had encountered earlier.
target: “Intelligo…” meminit Franca de viro quem antea convenerat.

source: The man, who also appeared to be a member of the School of Truth, had mentioned that he had a way to ensure the binding power of contracts on both parties.
target: Vir, qui etiam in Schola Veritatis adesse videbatur, dixit se modum habere ut vim obligatam contractuum utrisque partibus assecuraret.

source: “And then?” Jenna pressed.
target: “Et deinde?” quaesivit Jenna.

source: Jebus suddenly felt a little embarrassed.
target: Jebus repente modicum erubuit.

source: He coughed twice and said, “We can also rely on symbolic shadow power to secretly modify key terms the moment the contract is signed, making the other party offer more or less.”
target: Bis tussivit et dixit: “Possumus etiam potestate umbrae symbolicae confidere, qua occulte clausulas fundamentales in momento contracti subsignationis mutare possimus, ut altera pars plus aut minus proferat.”

source: “No wonder…” Franca finally understood how the man suspected of being a member of the School of Truth had deceived her and Jenna.
target: “Non mirum…” tandem intellexit Franca quomodo vir, qui membrum Scholae Veritatis esse suspicabatur, eam et Jennam deciperet.

source: No wonder he had revealed an abnormality once she mentioned divining the contract in advance!
target: Non mirum quod ille anomaliam revelaverit, cum illa praevia divinationem contracti commemoret!

source: Shadow Merchants are well-suited for dealing with Beyonders of the Marauder pathway.
target: Mercatores Umbrae aptissimi sunt in rebus agendis cum Beyonderibus viae Praedatoris.

source: I wonder which side will ultimately suffer…
target: Miror qua pars denique patietur…

source: Lumian didn’t give Franca a chance to criticize the Shadow Merchant.
target: Lumian Francae occasionem non dedit ut Mercatorem Umbrae reprehenderet.

source: He chuckled and questioned, “What about Sequence 7?”
target: Subridens quaesivit: “Quid de Sequentia VII?”

source: “Sequence 7 is Prosecutor,” Jebus introduced, as if trying to compensate for the Shadow Merchant’s dark image.
target: “Sequentia VII est Prosecutor,” inquit Jebus, quasi imaginem obscuram Mercatoris Umbrae compensare conaretur.

source: “A Prosecutor has two abilities.
target: “Prosecutor duas facultates possidet.

source: One allows them to discern a target’s crimes, but they can’t witness the process.
target: Una eos sinit crimina obiecti discernere, sed processum videre non possunt.

source: The other is based on the first ability.
target: Alterum primā facultate innititur.

source: First, declare the other party guilty, then point out the specific crime…”
target: Primum, alteram partem reum declara, deinde crimen specificum designa…

source: Franca turned puzzled.
target: Franca vultum perplexum constituit.

source: “How can this crime be determined?
target: “Quomodo hoc crimen determinari potest?

source: “It can’t be based on Intis law, can it?
target: “Nonne id in legibus Intis fundari non potest?

source: If we meet in the Loen Kingdom, won’t your abilities be useless?
target: Si in Regno Loen conveniamus, num facultates tuae inutiles erunt?

source: “Do they automatically adapt to local laws?”
target: “Num ipsa statim legibus localibus se accommodant?”

source: This seemed to be the first time Jebus had been asked this question.
target: Hoc primum videbatur, cum Jebus hanc quaestionem audivisset.

source: After more than ten seconds of thought, he replied,
target: Post plus quam decem secundis cogitationis, respondit:

source: “It’s likely an act recognized as a crime by most humans.
target: “Verisimiliter actus est, quem plerique homines crimen agnoscunt.

source: It includes blasphemy, murder, rape, fraud, theft, and so on.
target: Includit blasphemia, caedem, stuprum, dolum, furtum, et cetera.

source: Nothing more detailed or categorized.”
target: Nihil magis definitum aut categorice dispositum.

source: Franca remained unconvinced.
target: Franca non convincitur.

source: “That’s not right either.
target: “Id quoque non est rectum.

source: Suppose we enter a ridiculous world where we can do whatever we want, including murder and blasphemy.
target: Supponamus nos in mundum ineptum ingredi, ubi quidquid volumus facere possimus, inter caedem et blasphemia.

source: Wouldn’t that prevent you from declaring the target guilty?”
target: Num id non impediat te alteram partem reum declarare?

source: She was thinking of the recently concluded Dream Festival.
target: Ea de nuper concluso Festo Somniorum cogitabatur.

source: Jebus fell silent for a moment before responding, “I don’t know…”
target: Jebus momentaneum silentium tulit antequam responderet: “Nescio…”

source: “Perhaps the charges stem from something more fundamental,” Lumian speculated.
target: “Fortasse accusationes ex aliquo fundamento oriuntur,” speculavit Lumian.

source: Jebus couldn’t be certain.
target: Jebus certus esse non potuit.

source: Franca could only look at him and say, “Continue.”
target: Franca solum in eum aspicere potuit et dicere: “Perge.”

source: Jebus took a moment to recall where he had left off.
target: Jebus paulisper recordatus est ubi desierat.

source: “After pointing out the crime, the target will receive the corresponding punishment from the world itself or some entity.
target: “Postquam crimen designatum est, obiectum poenam correspondentem a mundo ipso aut aliqua entitate accipiet.

source: The exact punishment depends on the severity of the target’s crime.
target: Poena certa pendet ex severitate crimini obiecti.

source: We can’t know in advance.
target: Non possumus praeviam scire.

source: In short, from my experience, the most terrifying punishments are immediate death and loss of control on the spot.
target: In summa, ex mea experientia, poenae terribilimae sunt mors statim et in loco imperii amissio.

source: “In addition, for ongoing crimes, we can directly declare the target guilty.
target: “Praeterea, pro crimine permanente, obiectum directe reum declarare possumus.

source: There’s no need to specify the charges, effectively saving time.”
target: Non est necesse accusationes enuntiandi, quo tempus efficaciter servetur.”

source: Franca nodded slightly, gaining a new understanding of the battle.
target: Franca parum annuit, novam de proelio intellegentiam capiens.

source: “What language did you use when you announced the charge?” Lumian recalled the corresponding details.
target: “Quae lingua usus es, cum accusationem pronuntiavisti?” meminit Lumian singularia.

source: “It’s the Words of Order.
target: “Sunt Verba Ordinis.

source: I automatically learned it when I received the Prosecutor’s boon,” Jebus confessed.
target: Eam statim didici, cum beneficium Prosecutoris acceperim,” confitebatur Jebus.

source: Lumian offered a curt acknowledgment.
target: Lumian compendiose assentivit.

source: “What about Sequence 6?”
target: “Quid de Sequentia VI?”

source: “It’s the Ambitionist,” Jebus said, his eyes seeming to blaze with flames.
target: “Est Ambitionist,” inquit Jebus, oculis quasi flammas ardentes ostendentibus.

source: “An inexhaustible ambition brings about a powerful physique, keen perception, and outstanding spirituality, driving us to constantly pursue improvements in our combat abilities.
target: “Ambitio inexhausta efficit corpus potentem, sensum acutum, atque spiritualitatem praeclaram, quae nos impellit ut constantiter in facultatibus pugnae nostræ meliorationes quaeramus.

source: And our burning ambitions make us unwilling to rest for a moment.
target: Et ardentes ambitiones nostrae nos impellunt ut neque momentum quietis petamus.

source: Unless we’re prepared to sleep, no one can force us to sleep or faint…”
target: Nisi parati simus ad dormiendum, nemo nos dormire aut evanescere coercebit…

source: “In other words, it can effectively resist being forced into dreams, comas, and other debilitating states?
target: “In aliis verbis, an id efficaciter resit coercitioni in somnia, comas, et alias debilitantes status?

source: Or is it outright immunity?” Lumian immediately understood why Jebus could wake up so quickly when facing the Spell of Harrumph.
target: An potius prorsus immunis sit?” statim intellexit Lumian, cur Jebus tam celeriter expergisci posset, cum incantationem “Harrumph” opposerit.

source: “It’s resistance,” Jebus admitted candidly.
target: “Est resistentia,” confitebatur Jebus candiditer.

source: Lumian inquired further about Ambitionists before asking, “You should be at Sequence 5, right?”
target: Lumian de Ambitionistis ulterius interrogavit, deinde quaesivit: “Sequentia V esse debet, nonne?”

source: “Yes.” Jebus puffed out his chest in front of the two Demonesses.
target: “Ita.” Jebus pectus extulit coram duabus Demonissis.

source: Franca asked curiously, “What’s Sequence 5?”
target: Franca curiosa quaesivit: “Quid est Sequentia V?”

source: Jebus replied with a smile, “It’s Under the Table.”
target: Jebus subrisu respondit: “Est Sub Mensa.”

source: Under the Table? Franca, Lumian, and the others simultaneously thought of the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑Table Transaction they had obtained from General Philip.
target: “Sub Mensa?” Franca, Lumian, et ceteri simul meminerunt transactionem “Sub Mensa” a Possessore Auctoritatis, quam ab Generali Philippo obtinerant.

source: Could it be formed by the power of a Sequence 5 boon of the Broker pathway?
target: Possitne ea formari ex potestate beneficii Sequentiae V viae Intermediarii?

source: Lumian gazed at Jebus, in no hurry to comprehend the hidden box’s abilities.
target: Lumian Jebum intuebatur, non festinatus ad facultates arcae absconditae intellegendas.

source: He asked thoughtfully, “What’s your connection to the Carbonari?”
target: Quaesivit meditans: “Quae est tua connexio ad Carbonarios?”
